blockingEvidence.detail: The Docker daemon starts and works. The agent network proxy denies Docker Hub's blob CDN at CONNECT level: production.cloudfront.docker.com:443 returns 'gateway answered 403 to CONNECT (policy denial)'. Manifest resolution reaches registry-1.docker.io (401 auth challenge) but blob download is refused, so node:20-alpine@sha256:fb4cd12c... cannot be pulled and no base image is cached.

blockingEvidence.notWorkedAround: The proxy README lists policy denials under 'Not supported through the proxy (report, do not work around)'.
blockingEvidence.consequence: No image tag, image ID or digest exists, so §17 image fields cannot be filled and no approval may be requested.

findings.title: Playwright acceptance specs are coupled to a dataset the repository cannot produce
findings.evidence: tests/e2e/acceptance.spec.ts navigates to /products/power-bank-20000mah. The tracked scripts/seed.ts never creates that slug; it creates heavy-duty-power-bank. The live API served 8 approved products, none with the expected slug.
failingTests: acceptance.spec.ts:19 shop search finds the catalogue product and zero-result CTA appears
acceptance.spec.ts:29 PDP shows verified compatibility with its condition note
findings.assessment: Not a storefront defect. The e2e suite depends on fixture data that is not in the repository, so it cannot pass against the repository's own seed. Repairing it requires the intended dataset; inventing product facts is forbidden by CLAUDE.md and controller §13.

findings.title: automation-a4 e2e test connects to PostgreSQL on the default port
findings.evidence: tests/e2e/automation-a4.spec.ts:52 failed with connect ECONNREFUSED 127.0.0.1:5432 while the session database ran on 55432 and DATABASE_URL was exported.
findings.assessment: A component in the browser-driven path resolves the database independently of the exported DATABASE_URL. Needs confirmation on a host where 5432 is the real port before deciding whether it is a defect or a harness assumption.
